title: Life Is Roblox (DJ Khaled)
blurb: DJ Khaled, a man not known for understatement, compared existence itself to a children's block game and meant every word of it. The internet enshrined 'life is Roblox' immediately, because it lands somewhere between accidental philosophy and complete nonsense and never resolves either way. Play it when reality visibly glitches, when somebody in the street behaves exactly like an NPC on a walk cycle, or when the simulation shows a seam you were not meant to see. He said what he said, and honestly he might be right.
origin: DJ Khaled's viral 'life is Roblox' interview moment.
